activities.activity_description: Add a new shell command to Spring Cloud Data Flow shell that displays runtime details (host, port) for a given module. Includes command registration, parsing module metadata, and output formatting.

Develop functionality to deploy Spring Cloud Data Flow applications on a YARN cluster. Includes integration with YARN resource manager, packaging application as a YARN application, configuration, and testing.

activities.activity_name: Port file module from XD to s-c-s
activities.activity_description: Port the file source/sink module from Spring XD to Spring Cloud Stream. Adapt configuration, dependencies, and APIs to match the s-c-s model. Includes unit and integration tests.

activities.activity_name: Refactor build to bundle SPI deployers individually
activities.activity_description: Break the monolithic build lifecycle to produce separate deployer SPI JARs. Refactor Maven POMs to create multi-module structure, ensure individual deployer artifacts are buildable and testable independently.
Identify and replace all usages of XDRuntimeException from XD with appropriate standard Java runtime exceptions. Update imports and ensure backward compatibility where needed.

activities.activity_name: Update gemfire sink to latest release
activities.activity_description: Upgrade the GemFire sink module to use the latest GemFire client version. Update configuration, verify connectivity and data ingestion, and run compatibility tests.

activities.activity_name: Create and publish SFTP source module
activities.activity_description: Develop a new SFTP source module for Spring Cloud Stream. Implement file polling via SFTP using a library like JSch, integrate with the module framework, package, and publish to the Maven repository.
Analyze existing CI pipelines (Jenkins) for Spring Cloud Data Flow and related projects. Add missing jobs for automated testing on commits, fix pipeline failures, and improve monitoring.

Perform system-level integration testing of all changes together, ensure no regressions, validate end-to-end workflows (e.g., deploy on YARN, use SFTP source, etc.). Also includes documentation updates and release preparation.
